# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and matches the issue or task.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated where relevant.
- [ ] RTL behavior was considered and checked where relevant.
- [ ] Accessibility was considered and checked where relevant.
- [ ] Privacy impact was considered and documented where relevant.
- [ ] Documentation was updated where relevant.
- [ ] No copyrighted assets were added without permission and license details.
- [ ] Content review was completed where educational content changed.

## Verification

List commands run and their results. Do not write "not run" as "passed".

## Notes

Mention known limitations, follow-up work, or review areas.
